hook.en: Lifting your arm overhead is a team effort of four joints. Learn the 2:1 rhythm, the force couples that drive it and what a 'winging' scapula really means.
hook.ur: Haath upar uthana chaar joints ki team ka kaam hai. 2:1 rhythm, isay chalane wale force couples aur 'winging' scapula ka asal matlab seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe how the scapula and humerus share arm elevation, name the force couples involved and assess scapular movement sensibly in shoulder patients.
goal.ur: End tak aap bata sakenge ke arm elevation scapula aur humerus kaise share karte hain, involved force couples ka naam le sakenge aur shoulder patients mein scapular movement samajhdari se assess kar sakenge.

text.en: The 'shoulder' is really four joints: the **glenohumeral** joint, the **scapulothoracic** articulation, and the **acromioclavicular** and **sternoclavicular** joints. Full elevation (about 180°) needs all of them working together.
text.ur: 'Shoulder' asal mein chaar joints hain: **glenohumeral** joint, **scapulothoracic** articulation, aur **acromioclavicular** aur **sternoclavicular** joints. Poori elevation (taqreeban 180°) ke liye sab ko mil kar kaam karna parta hai.

text.en: **Scapulohumeral rhythm:** over full elevation, the glenohumeral joint contributes roughly twice as much as the scapula — about **2:1**, i.e. ~120° glenohumeral and ~60° scapular upward rotation. The ratio varies between people, planes and loads; the first ~30° of abduction is a 'setting phase' where the scapula moves little and variably.
text.ur: **Scapulohumeral rhythm:** poori elevation mein glenohumeral joint scapula se taqreeban do guna hissa daalta hai — takreeban **2:1**, yani ~120° glenohumeral aur ~60° scapular upward rotation. Yeh ratio logon, planes aur loads ke saath badalta hai; abduction ke pehle ~30° 'setting phase' hain jahan scapula kam aur mukhtalif tareeqe se hilti hai.

simpler.en: For every 3° the arm goes up, about 2° happen at the ball-and-socket and 1° from the shoulder blade turning upward.
simpler.ur: Haath ke har 3° upar jane mein taqreeban 2° ball-and-socket se aur 1° shoulder blade ke upar ghoomne se aate hain.

question.en: A patient elevates the arm to 150°. Using the classic 2:1 rhythm, roughly how much came from scapular upward rotation?
question.ur: Patient haath 150° tak uthata hai. Classic 2:1 rhythm ke hisaab se taqreeban kitna scapular upward rotation se aaya?

feedback.en: Yes — one-third of 150° is 50° scapular, 100° glenohumeral (as a rough guide).
feedback.ur: Haan — 150° ka ek tihai 50° scapular, 100° glenohumeral (mota andaza).

feedback.en: That's the glenohumeral share — the bigger part.
feedback.ur: Yeh glenohumeral ka hissa hai — bara hissa.

text.ur: Bilkul nahi — scapula ruki rehti hai

feedback.en: Without scapular rotation you couldn't elevate much beyond about 120°.
feedback.ur: Scapular rotation ke baghair taqreeban 120° se zyada elevate nahi kar sakte.

text.en: As the arm rises, the scapula **upwardly rotates**, **tilts posteriorly** and **externally rotates** on the thorax, and the clavicle elevates and rotates backwards. This keeps the glenoid under the humeral head and creates space under the acromion for the rotator cuff.
text.ur: Haath uthne ke saath scapula thorax par **upward rotate**, **posterior tilt** aur **external rotate** karti hai, aur clavicle elevate ho kar peeche ghoomti hai. Is se glenoid humeral head ke neeche rehta hai aur acromion ke neeche rotator cuff ke liye jagah banti hai.

title.en: Two force couples you should know
title.ur: Do force couples jo aap ko maloom hone chahiye

rows.en: Upper trapezius + lower trapezius + serratus anterior
rows.ur: Upper trapezius + lower trapezius + serratus anterior

rows.en: Rotate the glenoid upward; serratus also holds the scapula against the ribs
rows.ur: Glenoid ko upar ghumana; serratus scapula ko pasliyon se bhi chipkaye rakhta hai

rows.en: Deltoid + rotator cuff (especially infraspinatus, teres minor, subscapularis)
rows.ur: Deltoid + rotator cuff (khaas kar infraspinatus, teres minor, subscapularis)

rows.en: Deltoid lifts; cuff compresses and depresses the head so it stays centred
rows.ur: Deltoid uthata hai; cuff head ko dabakar neeche rakhta hai taake center mein rahe

rows.en: Deltoid pulls without the cuff's downward pull
rows.ur: Cuff ke neeche khinchav ke baghair deltoid khenchta hai

rows.en: Humeral head rides up — shrugging 'hitch', weak elevation
rows.ur: Humeral head upar sarakta hai — kandhe ucha karne wala 'hitch', kamzor elevation

text.en: The scapula is the base of a crane; the humerus is the arm of the crane. If the base doesn't swivel and tilt to follow the arm, the crane arm hits its own frame — that's the space under the acromion getting crowded.
text.ur: Scapula crane ka base hai; humerus crane ka baazu. Agar base baazu ke saath ghoom aur jhuk na sake to crane ka baazu apne hi dhaanche se takra jata hai — yehi acromion ke neeche ki jagah ka tang hona hai.

text.en: **Scapular dyskinesis** is any altered position or movement of the scapula — e.g. medial border 'winging', early elevation (shrugging) or poor upward rotation. Observe the patient lifting and lowering the arms 3–5 times, ideally holding a light weight; the lowering phase often shows it best.
text.ur: **Scapular dyskinesis** scapula ki position ya movement mein koi bhi tabdeeli hai — maslan medial border ka 'winging', jaldi elevation (kandhe uchakna) ya kamzor upward rotation. Patient ko 3–5 dafa haath uthate aur neeche laate dekhein, behtar hai halka weight pakar kar; aksar neeche laane wala phase isay sab se wazeh dikhata hai.

text.en: Marked **medial winging** at rest or when pushing against a wall may mean a **long thoracic nerve palsy** (serratus anterior); **lateral winging** with shoulder drooping may mean **spinal accessory nerve** injury (trapezius) — e.g. after neck surgery or lymph node biopsy. These are neurological, not 'bad posture': check strength and refer for assessment.
text.ur: Aaram ki halat mein ya deewar par push karte waqt wazeh **medial winging** **long thoracic nerve palsy** (serratus anterior) ho sakti hai; kandha latakne ke saath **lateral winging** **spinal accessory nerve** injury (trapezius) ho sakti hai — maslan neck surgery ya lymph node biopsy ke baad. Yeh neurological hain, 'buri posture' nahi: strength check karein aur assessment ke liye refer karein.

question.en: During a wall push-up, the whole medial border of the right scapula lifts off the ribs. Which muscle is most likely weak?
question.ur: Wall push-up mein right scapula ka poora medial border pasliyon se uth jata hai. Kaun si muscle sab se zyada kamzor hone ka imkaan hai?

feedback.en: Trapezius weakness causes a drooping shoulder and lateral winging.
feedback.ur: Trapezius ki kamzori se kandha latakta hai aur lateral winging hoti hai.

feedback.en: Yes — serratus anterior holds the scapula against the thorax. Medial winging on pushing is its classic sign.
feedback.ur: Haan — serratus anterior scapula ko thorax se lagaye rakhta hai. Push karte waqt medial winging iski classic nishani hai.

feedback.en: Latissimus mainly extends and internally rotates the shoulder.
feedback.ur: Latissimus zyada tar shoulder ko extend aur internally rotate karta hai.

steps.title: Scapular assistance test
steps.detail: As the patient elevates the arm, assist upward rotation and posterior tilt by pushing up on the inferior angle. Less pain or more range = scapular contribution likely.

steps.title: Scapular retraction test
steps.detail: Manually stabilise the scapula in retraction, then re-test strength (e.g. empty-can). Stronger = scapular stability is part of the problem.

steps.title: Re-test the patient's own painful task
steps.detail: If the correction changes symptoms, include scapular work — but treat the whole person, not just the angle.

beats.ur:
1. Scapular assistance test — Patient haath uthaye to inferior angle ko upar dhakel kar upward rotation aur posterior tilt mein madad karein. Dard kam ya range zyada = scapula ka hissa mumkin.
2. Scapular retraction test — Scapula ko haath se retraction mein stabilise karein, phir strength dobara test karein (maslan empty-can). Zyada strong = scapular stability masle ka hissa hai.
3. Patient ka apna dard wala kaam re-test karein — Agar correction se symptoms badlein to scapular work shamil karein — lekin sirf angle nahi, poore insaan ka ilaaj karein.

text.en: The 2013 'Scapular Summit' consensus: dyskinesis is common in shoulder pain but also in people **without** pain, so it is a possible contributor — not proof of a cause. Use correction tests to see whether changing the scapula changes the symptoms, and combine scapular exercise with rotator cuff loading.
text.ur: 2013 'Scapular Summit' consensus: dyskinesis shoulder pain mein aam hai lekin **bina dard** logon mein bhi, is liye yeh ek mumkin wajah hai — sabit shuda wajah nahi. Correction tests se dekhein ke scapula badalne se symptoms badalte hain ya nahi, aur scapular exercise ko rotator cuff loading ke saath milayein.

question.en: A swimmer has slight scapular dyskinesis but no shoulder pain and full function. What should you do?
question.ur: Ek swimmer mein halki scapular dyskinesis hai lekin shoulder pain nahi aur function poora hai. Kya karna chahiye?

text.ur: Impingement diagnose karein aur swimming band karein

feedback.en: Dyskinesis without symptoms isn't a diagnosis — and rest isn't needed.
feedback.ur: Bina symptoms ke dyskinesis diagnosis nahi — aur rest ki zaroorat nahi.

text.en: Note it; consider preventive strength work if load is rising — no alarm
text.ur: Note karein; load barh raha ho to preventive strength work sochein — pareshani ki baat nahi

feedback.en: Right — it's common in pain-free athletes. Monitor and build capacity rather than label.
feedback.ur: Sahi — bina dard athletes mein aam hai. Label lagane ke bajaye monitor karein aur capacity banayein.

text.en: Refer urgently for nerve conduction studies
text.ur: Foran nerve conduction studies ke liye refer karein

feedback.en: Only marked winging with weakness suggests a nerve palsy.
feedback.ur: Sirf kamzori ke saath wazeh winging nerve palsy ki taraf ishara karti hai.

text.en: Treating it: start with education and the patient's painful task, then train the scapular force couple in useful positions — wall slides with a band, serratus punches, prone lower-trapezius raises — combined with rotator cuff strengthening. Progress from slow, controlled movements to the speed and load of the patient's work or sport, and re-check the painful task each session.
text.ur: Ilaaj: education aur patient ke dard wale kaam se shuru karein, phir scapular force couple ko kaam ki positions mein train karein — band ke saath wall slides, serratus punches, prone lower-trapezius raises — rotator cuff strengthening ke saath mila kar. Aahista, controlled movements se patient ke kaam ya sport ki speed aur load tak progress karein, aur har session mein dard wala kaam dobara check karein.

text.en: Common mistakes: blaming all shoulder pain on 'bad posture' or 'a weak scapula' without testing whether correction changes symptoms; prescribing only scapular squeezes and forgetting the rotator cuff; and missing a nerve palsy because winging was assumed to be weakness from disuse.
text.ur: Aam ghaltiyan: har shoulder pain ko 'buri posture' ya 'kamzor scapula' ka qasoor kehna bina test kiye ke correction se symptoms badalte hain ya nahi; sirf scapular squeezes dena aur rotator cuff ko bhool jana; aur winging ko istemal na hone ki kamzori samajh kar nerve palsy miss kar dena.

text.en: **2:1 and the three Rs of the scapula** — it Rotates up, Reclines (posterior tilt) and Rolls out (external rotation) as the arm rises.
text.ur: **2:1 aur scapula ke teen R** — haath uthne par yeh Rotate up karti hai, Recline (posterior tilt) karti hai aur Roll out (external rotation) hoti hai.

summary.en: Arm elevation needs four joints; overall about 2:1 glenohumeral to scapular motion.
summary.ur: Arm elevation ke liye chaar joints chahiye; majmui tor par taqreeban 2:1 glenohumeral to scapular motion.

summary.en: Trapezius–serratus and deltoid–cuff force couples rotate the scapula and keep the humeral head centred.
summary.ur: Trapezius–serratus aur deltoid–cuff force couples scapula ko ghumate aur humeral head ko center mein rakhte hain.

summary.en: Dyskinesis is common even without pain — test whether correcting it changes symptoms; marked winging with weakness may be a nerve palsy.
summary.ur: Dyskinesis bina dard bhi aam hai — test karein ke correction se symptoms badalte hain ya nahi; kamzori ke saath wazeh winging nerve palsy ho sakti hai.

back.en: About 2:1 glenohumeral to scapulothoracic (≈120°:60° over full elevation).
back.ur: Taqreeban 2:1 glenohumeral to scapulothoracic (poori elevation par ≈120°:60°).

front.en: Three scapular motions during arm elevation?
front.ur: Arm elevation mein scapula ki teen movements?

back.en: Upward rotation, posterior tilt, external rotation.
back.ur: Upward rotation, posterior tilt, external rotation.

front.en: Muscles of the scapular upward rotation force couple?
front.ur: Scapular upward rotation force couple ki muscles?

back.en: Upper trapezius, lower trapezius, serratus anterior.
back.ur: Upper trapezius, lower trapezius, serratus anterior.

front.en: Medial winging on pushing — which nerve?
front.ur: Push karte waqt medial winging — kaun si nerve?

front.en: What does the scapular assistance test do?
front.ur: Scapular assistance test kya karta hai?

back.en: Assists upward rotation/posterior tilt during elevation; less pain or more range suggests a scapular contribution.
back.ur: Elevation ke dauraan upward rotation/posterior tilt mein madad; dard kam ya range zyada = scapula ka hissa.

note.en: Where the rhythm and the force couples matter most.
note.ur: Jahan rhythm aur force couples sab se zyada aham hain.

note.ur: Scapular aur cuff loading ko milana.

note.ur: Chaar joints aur muscles tasveeron mein dekhein.
